# status-dot-icon.png

**Type:** Small status icon (an orange-red rounded square with a white dot in the centre).
**Source context:** `## Impacts identified` section, used inline three times in the impacts table, after the linked work item "AP-7806 - Improvements to TMF681" (status "open"). It is a status marker copied from the JIRA link and carries no information of its own beyond the status text next to it.
